uncounted_dynamic_resources.note: runtime returns bundle_path (credential-scrubbed tar.gz); apiUrl() downloads it. Not a literal route, so excluded from route count.

unclassified.why: frontend never calls it; prompts.update() comments say PUT is rejected (405) and emulates update via POST + DELETE. Go runtime does register PATCH /api/prompts/{prompt_id}. Contract should document POST+DELETE, not PUT/PATCH.
